description: The line plot illustrates the performance of two models, SMoE and SimSMoE, during validation, as measured by BPC (Bits Per Character), over the course of training. The x-axis represents the number of training steps, scaled by a factor of 10³, ranging from 0 to 50, while the y-axis shows the BPC value, ranging from 1.2 to 2.2. The black line, labeled "SMoE Validating," starts at a BPC of approximately 2.2 and rapidly decreases to around 1.2 by 20,000 training steps, after which it remains relatively stable. The magenta line, labeled "SimSMoE Validating," begins at a slightly lower BPC of about 2.1 and also decreases sharply, reaching a value of approximately 1.2 by 20,000 steps, where it stabilizes. Both models show a similar trend of rapid initial improvement followed by convergence, with SimSMoE achieving a slightly lower BPC throughout the training process.
